QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0:
The Memory Keeper tells you that the way to recall your lost memories is to go back where your adventure began.
Where is that, exactly? One place comes to mind...
QuestInfo.1:
Time to return to where it all began. 
The Eternal Forest.
QuestInfo.2:
The Memory Keeper advised you to return to where the adventure started.

Back when you looked at everything with wide-eyed curiosity. 
When you were so afraid of the dark path that you never set foot upon it. You remember it well.
When you were pondering whether to return to the Eternal Forest, Pan spoke to you.
He said #rhe#k was the start of your adventure, so there's no need to go anywhere else.

You can't help but love his honest face and soft paws, the paws that made the Memorial Staff for you.

Together with the Spirit Guides, you can always return to when the adventure began.
